judgement.reason: SFTPGo supports S3 storage backends and SQL databases, so a contained configuration change can make it run, which fits the with-changes outcome.

reviews.findingEvidence: Unsupported storage: the app declares durable local state (users_base_dir = /srv/sftpgo/data (Dockerfile)) with no VOLUME or Compose mount. Deployz provides object storage, not an attached data directory.
reviews.reason: The Dockerfile sets users_base_dir to /srv/sftpgo/data for user files, and the default SFTPGo config also keeps its data provider and backups on the local disk; no shown line selects S3 or a managed database for that data, so the finding is not disproved.
